name: Costco Wholesale (Logan & Draper, UT) Famous Rotisserie Chicken (Peeled Skin Hack)
whyItWorks: An absolute staple in Crohn's and colitis meal prep! Plump 3-lb whole chicken rotisserie-roasted until juicy and tender. Peeling off the salty skin leaves pure, unseasoned, tender white chicken breast that requires minimal digestive breakdown.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve warm breast meat and discard the seasoned outer skin. Pair with white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Discard the seasoned outer skin to avoid excess grease and spice rub
